cleansingStrength.rationale: Low by C6: no strong anionic anywhere; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the mild anionic taurate Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate @2, with prominent nonionic/amphoteric co-surfactants Decyl Glucoside @3, Cocamidopropyl Betaine @4 and Coco-Glucoside @8. Disodium Tetrapropenyl Succinate @13 is at most a carboxylate-type mild anionic by chemistry and cannot change C6.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Disodium Tetrapropenyl Succinate @13 role unclear; nothing strong.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High by the Section 5 high anchor (rich architecture, W-RICH read with E3): a prominent payload lipid (Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil @6; also waxy Hydrogenated Castor Oil @11) converges with a prominent silicone (Amodimethicone @9) and cationic polymer (Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @10), plus pearlizing Glycol Distearate @14 and a starch polymer @7. C2 itself is not met: the deliberate humectant element is missing (no closed-list humectant; Hexylene Glycol @16 is a solvent), which is recorded as the counter-signal and lowers confidence to moderate with moderate as neighbor.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Missing humectant element; all deposition after NaCl @5.

weak_refatter: Coconut Acid @12 (fatty acid; refatter by analogy, family uncertain)
unresolved: Sodium Hydrolyzed Potato Starch Dodecenylsuccinate @7 (hydrophobically modified anionic starch; emulsion-stabilizing or light film/conditioning role, not resolved in 6.4; can only add deposition, so it cannot move the band lighter)
Disodium Tetrapropenyl Succinate @13 (alkenyl succinate; co-surfactant/hydrotrope role unclear; no deposition role)
